summary: One-frame request to fill the mod.io info cache, posted by gui::AvailableModsSystem (macOS Update writes it) and read by ls::ugc::ModInfoCachedRequestSystem (macOS GatherRequests; Windows per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3BE8230). Two HashSet<ls::ugc::ModItemInfoID>. Registry total 96 (client row).

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: Windows HashSet<ls::ugc::ModItemInfoID> insert bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 hashes the qword at +0 and the find bg3.exe+0x12705B0 compares it first (key stride 0x20); macOS ModInfoCachedRequestSystemHelper::RequestItemInfo(unsigned long long, Optional<Version>, bool, EHardwareType) takes the members in this order (mod id first).

fields.name: Version
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 hashes +8 only when the byte at +0x10 is set, and bg3.exe+0x12705B0 compares +8 only when both +0x10 bytes are set: the value of an optional (macOS Ensure<ModItemInfoID> identical) - the Optional<Version> argument.

fields.name: HasVersion
fields.evidence: has-value flag of the optional at +8 (bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 / bg3.exe+0x12705B0).

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x12705B0 compares the byte at +0x18 (not hashed); the bool argument of RequestItemInfo by order.

fields.name: HardwareType
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x126FEA0 hashes the int at +0x1C and bg3.exe+0x12705B0 compares it: the EHardwareType argument of RequestItemInfo by order (enum not declared in Script Extender; 4 bytes).

fields.name: RefreshHashKeys
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x12706D0 (AllocRaw 0x60) zeroes two HashSet patterns (+0, +0x30); destructor bg3.exe+0x6C6A10 runs the plain-key HashSet destructor bg3.exe+0x582AD0 on +0x30 and +0. bg3.exe+0x3BE8B10 (ModInfoCachedRequestSystem gather step) unions the set at +0 into its first request set and the set at +0x30 into its second one (FUN_143bea2f0 walks the keys at set+0x20 with stride 0x20, count set+0x2C); afterwards ids already in the info cache are removed from the second set only (lines after the gather: CacheModInfoSingleton keys stride 0x20) - so +0 are requests that bypass the cache, +0x30 requests the cache may answer - bucket array of ls::HashSet
